## DESCRIPTION (paste into the description box — plain text/markdown works)

```
CHRONO turns Grand Theft Auto V into a living, reactive world where your actions have real consequences — and where you have superpowers to deal with them.

WHAT IS CHRONO?
A ScriptHookVDotNet mod that adds a complete justice system to GTA V: commit crimes and the world notices, reacts, and makes you pay. Use superpowers to escape — or face the consequences.

FEATURES
• Superpowers: Dash (X), Time Stop (Z), Invisibility (B), Fly, God Mode, Map Teleport — all in the CHRONO menu (Shift+0)
• Full justice system: wanted stars, physical arrests (you get cuffed), police escort to Bolingbroke, court rulings, prison sentences
• Manhunts: escape from prison and trigger a city-wide manhunt — stay ahead of the heat
• Live WEBNET feed: news reacts to your crimes in real time; civilians recognize you, call the police, and spread the word
• Reputation system: notoriety, fame, warrants, identities — your criminal record persists between sessions (SQLite database)
• Witness reactions: use your superpowers in public and civilians flee in terror — or post about it on WEBNET
• Mission-safe: justice pauses during story missions automatically
• New-game safe: starting a fresh story archives your old record — never deleted

INSTALLATION
Option A (easiest): download Chrono-Setup-1.0.0.exe — the installer finds your GTA V folder automatically and installs everything, including ScriptHookV/ScriptHookVDotNet if you don't have them.
Option B (manual): extract Chrono-v1.0.0.zip and copy the "Chrono" folder into <GTA V folder>\scripts\ (create the folder if needed).

REQUIREMENTS
• GTA V (Enhanced or Legacy)
• ScriptHookV + ScriptHookVDotNet 3 (included in the one-click installer)

KEYS (default — change in scripts\Chrono\config.json)
• CHRONO menu: Shift+0
• Dash: X · Time Stop: Z · Invisibility: B
• Interact (bail / skip transport): G

GAME NOTES
• A fresh story (≤5 missions passed) resets the criminal record automatically (archived, never deleted)
• Story missions pause the justice system ("MISSION — ON STANDBY")

DISCLAIMER
Free for personal use. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Use at your own risk.

Made by Firdaus — FIRDAUS BUILDS
YouTube: youtube.com/@firdausbuilds · GitHub: github.com/fdfrontdev
```
